jobs.description:
Middlegate Europe is a leading player in European logistics and distribution. With operational sites
in Zeebrugge, Liège, and Hull, the company combines innovative processes with a strong focus on safety,
quality, and operational reliability. To strengthen the team in Zeebrugge, Middlegate Europe is looking for an
International Truck Driver.
 

JOB DESCRIPTION
 
 

• Responsible for delivering goods within the specified time frame. 

• Complying with legal driving and rest periods. 

• Assisting with loading and unloading trucks and ensuring the cargo is secured. 

• Ensuring the vehicle is kept in perfect condition and clean. 

PROFILE
 
 

• You have a valid CE driver’s license. 

• You have some initial experience as a CE driver. 

• You are punctual, professional, and thorough in your work. 

• You speak Dutch or English well. 

• You have a flexible mindset. 

• You’re willing to spend the night on location.

Due to a large number of opportunities, we are looking for a driven 
Sales Coordinator / Tender Specialist to strengthen the Sarens Projects team. In this role, you aim to provide clients with a structured, solution-oriented, and clear proposal within the agreed timeline. In collaboration with the Key Account Manager, you clarify the proposal and respond to the client's questions. 
 

Your future responsibilities as a Tender Specialist include: 
 

• Analyzing and summarizing client requests. 
 

• Developing proposals for technical requests and projects in collaboration with the responsible Key Account Manager to achieve the best balance between budget, scope, and timing according to client needs. 
 

• During the bidding process, you collaborate with various support departments such as engineering, logistics, HR, SHEQ, finance, etc. You coordinate their input and deliverables while respecting deadlines to create a structured, high-quality proposal that meets both internal and external expectations. 
 

• Regularly consulting with the responsible Key Account Manager and the sales support team about the proposed solution, adjusting as needed. 
 

• Gathering the necessary cost inputs, preparing a price calculation, and reviewing it with the Key Account Manager and/or management. 
 

• Timely and accurately submitting proposals/tender documents after internal approval and following up on them with the Key Account Manager. Responding to internal and external questions and making adjustments where needed. 
 

• Acting at all times as a proud 
Sarens Ambassador and providing general sales support to the group. 

We are looking for a stress-resistant multitasker with a hands-on mentality, strong writing skills, and a solution-focused, positive attitude. You have a strong interest in the world of specialized transport and heavy lifting. You possess good reading and listening skills, enabling you to detect and anticipate customer needs. You think outside the box in search of the best solution. You are a sociable team player with a strong sense of responsibility. You work in a structured and precise manner, with attention to detail. Customer focus, drive, and proactivity are key to success in this role. 
 

Your profile: 
 

• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in a technical field (engineering, electromechanics, construction...) or equivalent through experience. 
 

• Interest in or experience with sales support, technical inside sales, tender engineering, etc. 
 

• Technical knowledge of heavy lifting and/or exceptional transport, or a strong eagerness to learn and acquire this knowledge quickly. • Strong communicator in Dutch; good knowledge of English and French. 
 

• Proficient with computers (including MS Office).

I am looking for an energetic, friendly and kind trilingual secretary to join my new private gynaecological practice.
 

The successful candidate must be fluent in Dutch, English and French. This is a part-time, on-site position starting on 7 December 2026.
 

Responsibilities include:
 
 

• Answering telephone calls and assisting patients 

• Managing the reception desk 

• Scheduling and following up on appointments 

• Tracking and ordering practice supplies 

• Cleaning and preparing medical instruments according to protocol 

• Supporting the smooth day-to-day running of the practice  

A warm, professional and patient-centred attitude is essential.
